text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen, marking the finale of the spring GⅠ races.
Who will be the first to cross the finish line?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: The Umamusume upon whom each and every fan has placed their dreams are finally gathering in the paddock!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "—As scheduled, the Takarazuka Kinen will be held at Hanshin Racecourse."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To go over the final details with Biwa Hayahide,
we decided to hold one last meeting in the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now then, regarding the race development this time.
Trainer-kun, how were the other Umamusume performing in their previous races...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Now, while looking over there—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
To think they even compiled the training tendencies of each trainer.
Hmm, judging by the data, it looks like the pace will be high throughout.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
She came in second in the pre-race popularity poll,
so at the third corner she'll definitely... yeah.
In that case, I'll make my move from the second corner—...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, my meeting with Biwa Hayahide
went smoothly, and—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And here comes Biwa Hayahide!
In the fan poll held prior to the race—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Indeed! Allow me to show you all a race worthy of such praise today!
